why: The gallery CLI's hardcoded copy of the vocabulary keeps the two styles issue #1023 deleted, so `--identityMarker arcs` builds a capture URL the renderer resolves to the `shape` outline while the frame is labelled as something else. The two-way pin's loop over IDENTITY_MARKER_STYLES cannot see an extra name in the copy, so the literal rejects added beside it are what catch this.
killedBy: gallery args pins --identityMarker to the vocabulary the renderer actually owns
